name: List All Units Notes
description: Returns all notes for a unit that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[UnitId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unit ID. All GET requests must include a filter for [UnitId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter by last updated date from. All GET requests must include a filter for [UnitId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Body
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the unit note. A unit note cannot exceed 63,535 characters.

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: The unit to which the note will be attached

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the unit note's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the unit

responseFields.name: data[].NoteId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the unit. Deprecated in favor of Id.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
